# Händelserik vecka summeras – Stockholmsbörsen mot lugn öppning

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode is a Friday market wrap ahead of the US jobs report, covering a quiet Stockholm open and mixed earnings from foreign and Nordic names. The central case is a bearish thesis on defense contractor Saab, which the co-host recommends selling on valuation grounds versus faster-growing peers Rheinmetall and Kongsberg. Other themes include disappointing reports from Tokmanni and DraftKings against strong beats from Airbnb, Yubico and Clas Ohlson.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 SAAB-B — Saab | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Co-host published a sell recommendation in Finansmagasinet; valuation stretched (P/E >40, 117x cash flow) with capex-heavy ramp-up and execution risk.

#### Reasoning

Despite strong order intake, the co-host argues the stock has run ahead of fundamentals. SEK8bn/year capex to 2028 (tripling Global Eye capacity, Poland submarine build-out) strains cash flow and carries execution risk. Valuation leaves no room for error; peers Rheinmetall (~15x, 37-38% growth) and Kongsberg grow faster at higher margins and lower multiples. Nearly all analysts rate it sell; passive/index flows have inflated the price.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation premium versus Rheinmetall/Kongsberg compresses to fair
- if production ramp-up and capex execute without cash-flow problems
- if growth accelerates toward peer levels

> *"Jag skrev en analys i veckans nummer av Finansmagasinet med rekommendationen att sälja aktien."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

July sales up 15% (10% organic), strong growth across home markets and doubled sales in other markets under CEO Tornstrom; resilient consumer.

#### Reasoning

Hosts are impressed with Clas Ohlson's momentum: strong July sales, rapid growth since Tornstrom turned the company around, and a consumer that appears healthier than peers. No explicit buy call, but clearly positive commentary suggests continued strong execution; key-person risk if the CEO leaves for a bigger role (e.g. H&M).

#### Sell Triggers

- if CEO Tornstrom departs for another company
- if monthly sales growth decelerates sharply
- if consumer weakens

> *"Det tuffar på för Clas Ohlson verkligen."*

---

### ⛔ TOK1V — Tokmanni | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Multiple weak reports in a row and another miss despite lowered estimates; Dollarstore operating profit negative with write-downs; shares down ~10%.

#### Reasoning

Tokmanni keeps missing even after estimates were cut, with the Dollarstore unit deteriorating into negative operating profit and requiring EUR12m inventory and EUR24m goodwill write-downs. The stable Tokmanni chain cannot offset Dollarstore weakness. Full-year guidance reiterated but H2 is decisive; only hope is a new Swedish CEO in November. Hosts note downside is 'always 100%'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Dollarstore returns to profitability
- if new CEO turnaround gains traction
- if H2 beats reiterated guidance

> *"Redan pressad, men nedsidan är alltid 100 %, som bekant."*

---

### ⛔ DKNG — DraftKings | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Reported a loss instead of expected profit; down 3% after hours and -36% YTD; prediction-market opportunity cited but no near-term threat/benefit.

#### Reasoning

DraftKings disappointed by posting a loss versus an expected profit, and the stock is down 36% year-to-date. Management is upbeat on prediction markets but sees no threat to its core business yet. Weak momentum and earnings miss argue for caution.

#### Sell Triggers

- if profitability returns to guidance
- if prediction-market share gains materialize
- if YTD downtrend reverses

> *"Man levererar en förlust istället, man skulle levererat en vinst."*
